## Description
Provide a concise explanation of the changes made and the motivation.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Model/Benchmark adapter addition
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / performance enhancement

## Verification
- [ ] Unit tests added / passing locally (`pytest tests/unit`)
- [ ] Linting passing (`ruff check .`)
- [ ] Hardware tested (e.g., RTX 3050 6GB or CPU)
